meta.title: Trust your friends. Mostly.
meta.description: A social deduction game with public and private rooms. Gather your suspects, uncover the cult, and save a very suspicious little village.

hero.side_note: WELCOME TO THE END OF THE WORLD. MAYBE.
how_to_play.title: One village. Two sides.
how_to_play.intro: A tiny guide to a very bad night.
how_to_play.gather.label: 01 / GATHER
how_to_play.gather.title: Invite the usual suspects.
how_to_play.gather.description: Create a room and share the code, or find a public gathering. Everyone gets a secret role. Some get a much darker agenda.
how_to_play.deceive.label: 02 / DECEIVE
how_to_play.deceive.title: A little ritual after dark.
how_to_play.deceive.description: The cult chants. The Oracle investigates. The Veilweaver bends the truth. By day, every story deserves a second look.
how_to_play.decide.label: 03 / DECIDE
how_to_play.decide.title: Trust your gut. Or don’t.
how_to_play.decide.description: Discuss and vote to banish a suspect. Unmask all cultists to save the town—or finish the ritual to wake what waits below.
rules.summary: A few rules before the doom
rules.phases.title: Night, discussion, vote.
rules.phases.description: Act at night, then discuss and vote to banish a suspect. Nobody is banished if the vote ties or abstention wins. Mark ready to start voting sooner.
rules.role_card.title: Trust your role card.
rules.role_card.description: Your own role card tells the truth. Other players' claims and some investigation results can be misleading.
rules.curses.title: Curses are temporary.
rules.curses.description: Curses bring puzzles or confusion. Follow the on-screen instructions to clear them, or wait until the next dawn. The game keeps moving.
rules.ritual.title: More players, a longer ritual.
rules.ritual.description: Bigger villages need more chanting to complete the ritual. Your room shows its progress and the goal.
rules.final_vote.title: One last chance.
rules.final_vote.description: Town wins by banishing every cultist. When the ritual fills, the village gets one final discussion and vote. If any cultist survives, the Cult wins.
rules.setup.title: Make it your village.
rules.setup.description: Modes and expansions change the cast and rules. Check your lobby for the setup, and the glossary below for roles and terms.
footer.tagline: Made for friends. Not necessarily for friendships.
